modelOverview: Launched alongside the wider CODE 11.59 collection in 2019, the Tourbillon models pair the line's distinctive octagonal-within-round 41mm case with Audemars Piguet's in-house flying tourbillon calibres. Skeletonised and openworked executions expose the tourbillon cage and gear train through the dial, showcasing the brand's hand-finishing on a modern case architecture. AP has offered the complication in precious-metal and ceramic cases; stainless steel executions are rare and largely boutique or special-order pieces.

26398ST.OO.A002KB.01.movement: Automatic · Audemars Piguet Calibre 2980 flying tourbillon · ~65h power reserve · 21,600vph
26398ST.OO.A002KB.01.dial: Skeletonised/openworked dial exposing the flying tourbillon and gear train
26398ST.OO.A002KB.01.description: A CODE 11.59 flying tourbillon in the collection's architectural 41mm steel case, with the openworked dial laying bare the automatic flying tourbillon and its hand-finished bridges. This skeletonised execution is a rarer steel-cased variant of AP's in-house tourbillon platform rather than one of the standard precious-metal catalogue references. Every piece is sourced and authenticated prior to sale.

variants.Skeletonised – Steel: Stainless steel CODE 11.59 Tourbillon with a fully openworked, skeletonised dial revealing the flying tourbillon at 6 o'clock, the barrel, and the gear train, finished with applied luminous hour markers over the exposed movement architecture.
